title: Iran Hostages Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
Iran Hostages Congressional Gold Medal Act

This bill provides for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to the 53 hostages of the Iran Hostage Crisis (November 4, 1979-January 21, 1981) in recognition of their bravery and endurance throughout their captivity.

summary.headline: A 2022 law directs that a Congressional Gold Medal be awarded to the 53 Americans held hostage during the Iran Hostage Crisis.
summary.what_it_does: The law provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to the 53 hostages held during the Iran Hostage Crisis, which lasted from November 4, 1979, to January 21, 1981. The award recognizes their bravery and endurance during their captivity. The official summary does not describe the medal's design, the ceremony, or any money provided beyond the award itself.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022. The summary does not give a separate date for when the medal would be presented.
